prompt: Make slides explaining our microservices migration. We're moving from a Django monolith to 6 services: auth, billing, notifications, search, content, analytics. Show the migration phases, key risks, and the target architecture.

assertions.text: Loads Figtree and DM Sans fonts from Google Fonts
Uses navy (#1A1F5D or similar dark blue) as primary heading color
Uses reveal/fade-in animations with staggered delays
Implements spotlight hover on at least one component group
Mentions all 6 services (auth, billing, notifications, search, content, analytics) and Django monolith
